p.PACKAGE-INSTALLS-THE-TWO-PROCESS-MODEL: A vibevm `flow` package that installs the **two-process model** — the foundational mental model of the redbook collection.

p.the-human-and-the-ai-are-two-processors: The human and the AI are two processors with radically different architectures working one task:

facts.THE-HUMAN-OWNS-MEANING-MEMORY-AND-COHERE: the human owns meaning, memory between sessions, and coherence;
facts.THE-AI-OWNS-THROUGHPUT-CONSISTENCY-AND-S: the AI owns throughput, mechanical consistency, and formal structure.

p.FILES-ARE-THE-ONLY-MEMORY-THE-TWO-SHARE: Files are the only memory the two share.

p.both-default-metaphors-collapse-the-same: The two default metaphors — "boss and subordinate", "human and tool" — both collapse on real projects, and both for the same reason: the human ends up carrying one hundred percent of the cognitive load.

p.PACKAGE-INSTALLS-THE-ALTERNATIVE-AS-STAN: This package installs the alternative as standing session instructions plus three reference documents.

p.package-contents-lead: This package ships three pieces of content plus a boot snippet:

facts.CONTENT-THE-MODEL: `spec/flows/two-process-model/TWO-PROCESS-MODEL.xml` — the model: why the common metaphors fail, the complementary strengths table, the productive cycle, and the one assignment that never moves (the human owns coherence).
facts.CONTENT-THE-COGNITIVE-LOAD-SPLIT: `spec/flows/two-process-model/cognitive-load-split.xml` — the operational responsibility table: human-only work, AI-only work, shared work split by nature; and the four consequences of the AI's zero cross-session memory.
facts.CONTENT-FILES-AS-IPC: `spec/flows/two-process-model/files-as-ipc.xml` — the reframe of spec files from "documentation" to the inter-process channel: three planes, their budgets, and the four IPC requirements.
facts.CONTENT-THE-BOOT-SNIPPET: `spec/boot/05-flow-two-process-model.xml` — boot snippet loaded at session start: the architecture in brief and the never-do list.

p.UNINSTALL-REMOVES-EVERY-FILE-THE-PACKAGE: Uninstalling removes every file the package wrote, including the boot snippet.

p.this-flow-is-the-root-of-the-collection: This flow is the root of the redbook collection — the other members are its consequences:

facts.COMPOSES-THE-FOUR-IPC-REQUIREMENTS: The four IPC requirements map to `flow:addressable-specs` (addressability), `flow:git-atomic-commits` (atomicity), `flow:conflict-protocol` (conflict rules), and `flow:wal` plus `flow:sync-from-code` (visibility).
facts.COMPOSES-THE-MEMORY-ASYMMETRY: The memory asymmetry is operationalized by `flow:decision-records` (record decisions, not facts) and `flow:wal` (the checkpoint that survives the session).
facts.COMPOSES-DISCOVERY-PROMPT: Programming the AI process's reasoning posture for research is `flow:discovery-prompt`.

p.distilled-from-chapters-one-and-two: Distilled from *AI-native development*, chapter 1 («Два процесса, одна задача») and chapter 2 («Shared state: файлы как IPC»).

p.collections-spirit-is-the-redbook: The book ships in Russian inside `flow:redbook` at `spec/book/ru/`; the collection takes the general spirit of the process from it.
